instruction: Center align the heading and make the introductory paragraph bold in the Constitution template.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the docx file from the environment and parses it with python-docx.
Heading center-alignment check (doc.paragraphs[0].alignment == WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER) is logically correct for explicit alignment set via UI.
Body paragraph bold check (doc.paragraphs[2], all non-empty runs have run.bold is True) correctly verifies explicit bold formatting applied via Ctrl+B or toolbar.
Both instruction requirements (center-align heading, bold introductory paragraph) are fully covered by the evaluator.
Partial credit metric (0.5 + 0.5) is appropriate for the two-goal chained task.
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the file-based getter reads fresh state.
Error handling returns 0.0 on file-not-found or parse failures.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The run.bold is True strict identity check excludes None (style-inherited bold). If bold is applied via a paragraph or character style rather than explicit formatting, it may not be detected. Consider also checking the paragraph style's bold property as a fallback.

Hardcoded paragraph indices [0] (heading) and [2] (body) assume a specific document structure. If the downloaded document ever has empty leading paragraphs, these indices may be off. A more robust approach would scan paragraphs for the expected style name or content prefix.
